producer_report.summary: A job that edits docs/decisions.md is now held before the verifier, with the producer's one send-back, when a docs/decision-links.toml link no longer resolves. Links are keyed on the (older, newer) ids, with no line number. The check blames only what the change introduces, in four ways: a link no phrase of the candidate log names; a phrase the change adds that has no link; a statement-opening phrase with no id on a line the base log lacks; and a candidate list that does not parse. A fault already at the base is not blamed. It sits in `decision_gate`, which already runs in the producer loop and at the candidate. I moved the phrase parser (`HitKind`, `Hit`, `Parsed`, `parse_supersessions`) into athena-data and re-exported it from backtest, so the loop check and the backtest's condition (a) share one parser. `Link.line` is dropped, with a stray `line` in an older list still ignored. In the real list the D46/D79 and D87/D88 pairs are merged and the header gives no line-number advice. The gate sentence now tells the producer to write `Amends <id>` or `Supersedes <id>`. The advisory listing (`new_hits`, `citing_lines`, `citation_notes`) names docs/**/*.md lines outside the log that cite a decision the change adds a phrase for. A superseded decision lists every line (cap 40). An amended one lists the first 5 plus a count. It never fails a job. It is appended to the send-back of a held job and printed as `decisions  note:` lines at the candidate gate. D187 (`Amends D156`) is appended to the log, with its D156 to D187 link, and decision-sets.md §8 step 2 and CHANGELOG are updated. The D08 re-queue and the failure-class record are Athena actions outside this diff. Root cause: links carried the log line of their phrase, which shifts with any insertion, and nothing resolved them before the final verdict.
